$g=0; do { $p=AccessFix_Runner::run_batch($sid,5); $g++; } while(!is_wp_error($p)&&'running'===$p['status']&&$g<20); $t=time()-$ago_days*86400; $wpdb->update(AccessFix_Install::table('scans'),['started_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',$t),'finished_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',$t+40)],['id'=>$sid]); return $sid; } function ks_backdate_audit($from_id,$ago_days){ global $wpdb; $a=AccessFix_Install::table('audit'); $i=0; $rows=$wpdb->get_results($wpdb->prepare("SELECT id FROM $a WHERE id > %d ORDER BY id ASC",$from_id)); foreach($rows as $r){ $wpdb->update($a,['logged_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',time()-$ago_days*86400+$i*7)],['id'=>$r->id]); $i++; } } $A=AccessFix_Install::table('audit'); $IT=AccessFix_Install::table('issues'); ks_scan(6); ks_backdate_audit(0,6); $last=(int)$wpdb->get_var("SELECT MAX(id) FROM $A"); // A human reviews two findings and accepts them with a reason. $ign=0; foreach($wpdb->get_results("SELECT * FROM $IT WHERE status='open' ORDER BY id ASC") as $r){ if($ign<2&&in_array($r->check_id,['heading-empty','tabindex-positive','duplicate-id','img-alt-decorative'],true)){ $why=$ign===0?'Decorative divider, reviewed by the content editor.':'Accepted risk - third-party widget, vendor contacted.'; $wpdb->update($IT,['status'=>'ignored','ignore_reason'=>$why,'resolved_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',time()-5*86400)],['id'=>$r->id]); AccessFix_Audit::log(['post_id'=>$r->post_id,'url'=>$r->url,'check_id'=>$r->check_id,'criterion'=>$r->criterion,'action'=>'ignored','reason'=>$why,'before'=>$r->snippet]);
